# Scripts (DeepInit)

- `validate.ts` is the content gate. It stops after grammar errors, then checks mandatory cores, pacing, cap lines, ridge timing and reachability by playing the real engine (`scripts/validate.ts:228-280`).
- Pacing constants: floor 720 s, ceiling 1200 s, Circulation window 850 s, chapter-one timed ceiling 180 s (`scripts/validate.ts:29-34`). The floor and window bind only on `DIRECT_ROUTES` (`scripts/validate.ts:238-252`).
- `routes.ts` has its own exit bound of 2700 s (`scripts/routes.ts:445`), which differs from the validator.
- Route preferences hardcode content ids; stale ids surface as "names records content no longer has" (`scripts/validate.ts:270-273`).
- `browser-smoke.ts` (Playwright Chromium) writes screenshots and `smoke-results.json` into `playtest/` (`scripts/browser-smoke.ts:11`, `scripts/browser-smoke.ts:660`).
- `serve.ts` serves only four built files from `dist/` on 127.0.0.1:4173 (`scripts/serve.ts:4-14`).
